confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from web searches that returned mostly third-party aggregators (Numbeo/Expatistan-derived sites, travel guides). These figures are crowdsourced and sometimes disagree. Typical SEK figures were: cappuccino 40-50, 0.5 L draft beer 65-90, inexpensive meal 120-150, mid-range three-course dinner for two 600-1,000, cocktail 120-180, house wine glass 60-100. I converted SEK to USD at roughly 9.5 SEK per USD, an approximation from general knowledge and the rough USD figures in the search snippets, not a searched rate. Cocktail and wine are judgement picks within the searched ranges, set against beer at about 2x and 1.3x. The mid-range meal for two is the least certain food anchor because sources vary widely. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, with no accommodation searches and no live listings inspected. July is summer low season for Gothenburg business hotels, though leisure and event demand can raise rates. Registered 1-star options are scarce, so that anchor is the weakest.
comparable_city_reasoning: Gothenburg is priced as a slightly cheaper Swedish city than Stockholm, and one search result put its restaurants about 7-10% above the Swedish average. Its accommodation is broadly comparable to Copenhagen and Oslo at the budget end, and somewhat lower than those cities at the 3-star level in summer.
